correctness.rationale: The assigned RESULT.md is a negative anticanonical-degree witness for the precise smooth projective A4 fan of Lemire Proposition 7.6. Its adjacent maximal cones are <gamma1,gamma2,gamma3,v1> and <gamma1,gamma2,v1,gamma4> with primitive relation gamma3+gamma4-3v1=0. Standard smooth toric wall intersection gives (-K).C=1+1-3=-1. The relation was independently reconstructed in the five-coordinate A4 model; this is not a mere finite extrapolation. Hence -K fails nefness (weak Fano requires nef and big).

value.rationale: Whether a canonical smooth projective toric Demazure compactification is weak Fano is a motivated birational-positivity invariant. A concrete (-K)-negative invariant curve is a decisive, exact obstruction, restricting application of vanishing or weak-Fano tools; no full Mori-cone classification is required.

limitations: Final smooth A4 model only, not arbitrary toric Demazure models.
